description: Get company guidance from written Item 2.02 earnings releases and earnings-call transcripts, newest release first, with range, unit, GAAP basis, fiscal period and source provenance. Shows the newest 8 releases by default (about two years); maxReleases reaches older ones and fiscalYear narrows to the guidance for one fiscal year. Closed target periods are marked ended. Revenue and diluted-EPS guidance includes the reported actual and verdict once comparable XBRL facts exist; non-GAAP guidance is never compared with GAAP actuals. Coverage notes distinguish unprocessed documents from sources that state no guidance.

fiscalYear.description: Optional fiscal year on the company's own calendar (e.g., 2026): only guidance for a period in that year, from every release that gave it.

maxReleases.description: Number of releases to show, newest first (default: 8, clamped to 1-200). Pass a larger number for older guidance.

ticker.description: Stock ticker symbol (e.g., AAPL, MSFT), or MIC:TICKER (e.g., XPAR:AIR) for a listing outside the US.

name: GetGuidance
title: Company Guidance
